To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the user contributed tags, reflecting user attention, have the capability to enhance the image captioning.
we propose a dual attention model for the social image captioning task, which combines the visual and user attentions to generate the caption of social images.

(1) The proposed dual attention model for social image caption can be used to generate the captions that are both semantically and visually consistent with the image and the user-contributed tags; (2) The proposed dual-attention model can be used to automatically generate the captions that can be semantically and visually coherent with the image and user contributed tags.

the following questions: 1) how to combine the user contributed tags to generate the social image caption; 2) what is the difference between social image captioning and conventional image captioning? 3) what is the effect of user attention in the social image captioning?
